author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Deploy and test the accepted FastAPI app privately on Vultr
details: Package merged CS-028 with a digest-pinned Python base and allowlisted build context. Add a loopback-only private Compose stack, default-state smoke tool and opt-in real-image restart/replay tests. Deploy on the existing CPU host and verify laptop SSH-tunnel access. Remove this PR's tests/backend package marker to preserve the accepted separate discovery roots. Keep live acceptance blocked on CS-029/032, real model/worker readiness and deferred public TLS.
validation: Vultr: 40 component tests and 39 shared tests passed, including real built-image startup/restart and replay upload 202/duplicate 409, real Caddy proxy and TLS cases. Persistent private app returned health 200, readiness 503 and missing/invalid credentials 401 before/after Compose restart; laptop SSH tunnel passed. Windows: 40 component tests with four documented skips, 39 shared tests passed, replay rehearsal passed. No live sensing, complete WSS auth, public certificate or hardware acceptance claimed.
